Taj Mahal night viewing: full moon dates, tickets and rules

28 September 2026 · 5 min read

On five nights a month the Taj Mahal opens after dark: the night of the full moon and the two nights either side of it. Seeing the white marble under moonlight is something people travel a long way for — but it is tightly controlled, and the details matter.

How night viewing works

  • Five nights a month: full moon night, plus two nights before and two after
  • Between 8:00 pm and midnight, in eight half-hour batches of up to 50 people
  • You view the Taj from the Red Sandstone platform at the main gate — you do not go up to the mausoleum
  • Report to Shilpgram, near the East Gate, half an hour before your slot for the security check
  • Closed on Fridays and throughout the month of Ramzan

Night viewing ticket price

  • Indian adults: ₹510
  • Foreign adults: ₹750
  • Children aged 3 to 15: ₹500

Tickets are sold online through the ASI's official portal and usually go a day or so before the date. Carry the same ID you booked with — it is checked.

Is it worth it?

Honestly, it depends on the sky. On a clear night the dome glows; on a hazy winter night you may see a pale outline at a distance. Because you stay at the gate, it is a view rather than a visit. Most of our guests who do it love it — but we always pair it with a daytime or sunrise visit, never instead of one.

Three alternatives

  • Sunset from Mehtab Bagh, across the river — golden light and almost nobody else
  • A rooftop restaurant near the East Gate for a view of the dome after dark
  • The Taj Mahal sunrise tour — the most beautiful hour of all, every day except Friday

Frequently asked questions

Can you see the Taj Mahal at night?
Yes, on five nights around each full moon, between 8 pm and midnight, except on Fridays and during Ramzan.
How much is the Taj Mahal night ticket?
₹510 for Indian adults, ₹750 for foreign adults and ₹500 for children aged 3 to 15.
Can you go inside the mausoleum at night?
No. Night viewing is from the platform near the main gate only.
